'''Business and economy'''

The bank says the closures are required as a result of more customers using [[online banking]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Arnhem city fire]]
**Authorities begin demolishing [[façade]]s of historic buildings, including those that survived the [[Battle of Arnhem]], following a fire in the [[Arnhem|city]] in the [[Netherlands]] on March 6. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2560358-sloopwerk-door-brand-getroffen-gevels-arnhem-begonnen (NOS)]
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**The [[Corps of the Port Captaincies – Coast Guard|Italian Coast Guard]] retrieves the bodies of six [[human migration|migrant]]s, rescues 10 people, while 40 others remain missing after a [[dinghy]] carrying 56 people capsizes off the coast of [[Lampedusa]], [[Italy]], after departing from [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/italian-coast-guard-finds-6-bodies-40-missing-in-mediterranean/a-71970922 (DW)] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250319-italy-says-six-dead-40-missing-after-migrant-shipwreck (France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu]]
**[[Istanbul]] [[List of mayors of Istanbul|mayor]] [[Ekrem İmamoğlu]], who is also the main opposition figure against [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]], is arrested by [[Turkish Police]] along with more than 100 other people for alleged [[corruption]] and aiding [[terrorism]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-authorities-order-detention-istanbul-mayor-some-100-others-2025-03-19/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-istanbul-mayor-police-search-ead3dd38aa547ecd13bc336e7d6c4d58?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]
*[[Dakota Access Pipeline protests]]
**A [[jury]] in [[North Dakota]], United States, orders [[Greenpeace]] to pay at least $660 million to [[Energy Transfer Partners]], the company responsible for the [[Dakota Access Pipeline]], after ETP sued the organization for holding protests near [[Standing Rock Reservation]] concerning the violation of [[Tribal sovereignty in the United States|indigenous sovereignty]] of [[Native Americans in the United States|Native Americans]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/greenpeace-liable-for-millions-in-pipeline-lawsuit/a-71978898 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/mar/19/greenpeace-lawsuit-energy-transfer-dakota-pipeline (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Rohingya conflict]]
**[[Bangladesh Police]] arrest [[Ataullah abu Ammar Jununi]], the leader of the [[Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army]], a [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] [[insurgency|insurgent group]], in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], accusing him of leading and carrying out attacks against the [[Tatmadaw]] since 2016 along with charges of [[illegal entry]], [[murder]], and [[sabotage]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/bangladesh-arrests-leader-of-rohingya-insurgent-group/a-71967724 (DW)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/bangladesh-arrests-leader-of-rohingya-insurgent-group-on-criminal-charges (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Prosper family murders]]
**Nicholas Prosper, a 19-year-old who was convicted of killing three family members and plotting a [[school shooting]] in [[Luton]], [[Bedfordshire]], [[England]], in 2024, is sentenced to minimum of 49 years in prison without [[parole]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/british-teenager-who-killed-family-and-planned-school-massacre-gets-minimum-49-years-in-prison/ (CTV News)]      
*Four people are injured in a stabbing attack in [[Atwater, California|Atwater]], [[California]]. <ref>https://kmph.com/news/local/exclusive-graphic-video-captures-atwater-stabbing-rampage</ref>
